successful_prompt_sequence:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a colour-underpainting layer for a gentle, whimsical children's picture book.
Edit the supplied reference, using every existing line and its exact coordinates as a registration guide. It is an innocuous cartoon drawing of one foot and a lower leg with a cloth bandage wrapping around it. Preserve the complete simple rounded foot, toe, heel, long leaning ankle and original spiral fabric shape, including BOTH faint continuation lines at the top. Do not crop, resize, move, restyle or complete any other anatomy. Keep the original odd, friendly pen-drawing proportions and every irregularity.
Add ONLY very thin translucent watercolour: a pale warm peach/ochre wash in the original foot and ankle areas, nearly white ivory/slate wash in the existing cloth strips, and a tiny soft pigment shadow immediately below the existing sole. Restrained hand-painted watercolor texture, subtle paper pigment pooling, no glossy or plastic finish.
This is ONLY an underpainting. The final book overlays the exact unaltered original black pen master, so omit black outlines from your output; no replacement lines, no new details, no extra objects, no text.
Match the reference canvas aspect ratio, margins, framing and all relative positions exactly. Both faint top continuation lines must be accommodated by the coloured shape with spacious transparent margins. Return genuine transparency outside the existing shape and its small soft shadow: no white/cream paper rectangle or backdrop. Ignore the small graphite speck outside the bottom-left heel, which is photographic text residue.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a transparent watercolour underpainting; Image 2 is the original black-and-white registration reference.
Make ONE tiny correction at the very top of Image 1. The two pale upright source strokes above the bandage in Image 2 are the LEFT and RIGHT outer contour EDGES of ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS LOWER LEG. The colour between them must therefore be one continuous very pale peach wash. They must NOT appear as two separate narrow fingers, wooden sticks, rods, or prongs. Remove the erroneous narrow skin strip/prong look at the top and fill the space BETWEEN the original left and right outer edge coordinates with a single flat translucent peach wash, connecting seamlessly to the original bandage opening below. The open upper end may have a quiet straight/very gently sloped pale wash edge near the two existing stroke ends; add no new black line.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE in Image 1 exactly: foot, entire bandage, pigment texture, colour, proportions, shadows, exact canvas/framing, and transparent margins. Preserve the original top outer contour coordinates and faint original slant; do not move or crop anything. No new body or other objects, no black ink outlines. This is an underpainting only; the unaltered original pen artwork will be overlaid afterward. Output genuinely transparent outside the drawing, retaining existing transparency.
inspection_note: Both original pale top edges now bound one continuous pale skin wash. Entire foot/bandage composition included, no black replacement outlines, genuine transparent background. Subtle shadow reaches right canvas edge; top-left/top-right/bottom-left corner alpha 0, bottom-right corner alpha 2/255.
